meaning: Implementation audit, not full Oracle certification; includes commander and repeated basics.

priorities.reason: Selection spells and utility lands are already used; correct existing approximations before comparing decks.
Harmonic prowess, Storm-Kiln power, Baral loot and Stormsplitter expiry affect live board states.
Shared prerequisite for Twincast/Reiterate/Dualcaster/Sigil Tracer and magecraft/copy interactions.
Patron Wizard/Voidmage, Spellseeker, Mystical Tutor and transmute need explicit legal choices and costs.

priorities.area: Graveyard casting, replacement/layer breadth and combos
priorities.reason: Breach, alternate costs, type engines and candidate loops need reusable prerequisites and interruption tests.
